sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: General Kuranosuke Matsumoto is a Samurai General Mini-Boss in Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice. He is located in Ashina Castle.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
General Kuranosuke Matsumoto (侍大将 松本内蔵佑, Samurai General Matsumoto Kuranosuke) is a Mini-Boss with two Deathblow Counters.
As the First Prayer Necklace states, Ashina Generals are skilled samurai trained in the Ashina sword style.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Ashina Castle: at the top of the staircase past the Sculptor's Idol, delivering a speech to his troop.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: At the entrance of Ashina Castle | I'm sure you are all aware already. This coming battle will determine the fate of all Ashina. We go now to risk our lives for Lord Isshin and the people of Ashina. We are Ashina... We are unbreakable! Arrrghh! For Ashina!

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - As the first invasion of Ashina Castle by the Central Forces is triggered, this Mini-Boss will disappear for the rest of the playthrough. However, the Prayer Bead that he would have dropped will still be available in the Offering Box next to Hanbei for 1500 1500.
